name: Hashimoto Niina
source: The protagonist's sister and a big brocon. An honest and shy girl, she is extremely prone to crying. Naturally clumsy, she often falls down on flat grounds. Out of the four heroines she has the youngest appearance. She is very much interested in ecchi stuff, and actively tries to have get her brother to bang her during dates. Having said this she actually has zero experience or knowledge on these things.
